chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the contracted slave who commits adultery, he said: He is whipped for the Hadd penalty by the measure of what has been freed from him.

key_terms.المُكَاتَب: A slave who has entered into a contract with his master to pay a specific sum for his freedom
key_terms.الْحَدِّ: The fixed legal penalty prescribed by Sharia
key_terms.بِقَدْرِ مَا أُعْتِقَ مِنْهُ: By the measure of what has been emancipated from him (proportional to the paid portion)
key_terms.يَزْنِي: He commits adultery (specifically, the married slave or the one subject to the full hadd)

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd punishment for a contracted slave who commits adultery?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the proportional hadd punishment for a mukatab (freed slave via contract) who commits zina, ruling that the flogging count is reduced by the fraction of the emancipation price already paid. This reflects the juristic principle that the mukatab’s status is intermediate between a slave and a free person, with their legal liabilities scaling according to their remaining debt. The ruling underscores the practical application of equity in Shia fiqh, ensuring that the punishment corresponds to the individual's current degree of freedom.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

regarding the contracted (slave) who committed adultery. Heasws said: ‘He would be whipped regarding the Penalty (Hadd) by the measurement of what he has been emancipated (librated) from it (the contract)’.
